_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a property you can see (a vowel, a repeated letter, straight lines); 2: one fixed jump, or letters in a row; 3: jumps that change in a set way (+5, +6; +2, +3, +4), or places added up to a fixed total; 4: places added to make the third letter or a cube, multiplied, letters 13 apart, or letters and numbers together. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
